# agenticcarekit — full reference for language models

> agenticcarekit — the open-model stack for health AI. Runs on your laptop. Ships with the privacy boundary built in.

Single-file expansion of [llms.txt](llms.txt). Everything here is checkable against the
repository; nothing is aspirational unless it is explicitly labelled **roadmap**.

- **Version:** 0.1.0 · Apache-2.0 · Python >= 3.11
- **Command:** `ack` (alias: `agenticcarekit`)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/roshaninfordham/agenticcarekit
- **Telemetry:** none, ever. No analytics, no update check, no crash reporting.
- **Scope:** decision support only — documentation, navigation, accessibility, triage
  routing, education. Not diagnosis. Not treatment. Synthetic or public data only.
- **Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or derived from Apple Inc.**

## 1. What it is

Three things:

- **A scaffolder.** `ack init` runs thirteen concurrent machine probes, ranks
  open-weight models against a blueprint's declared requirements through a table of
  seven hard filters and nine soft scores, prints the reason for every choice, and
  generates a repository the user owns outright. Identical inputs produce a
  byte-identical tree.
- **A thin runtime.** Providers, the privacy boundary, trace, and four capabilities
  (voice, agents, extract, rag).
- **A local sidecar.** `ack serve` — the kernel over local HTTP (twelve `/v1` routes,
  OpenAPI, loopback-bound, `0600` token file) and `ack serve --mcp` over stdio with
  seven MCP tools. Policy, redaction and the trace live in that one process, so a thin
  client in any language cannot route around them.

**Not a framework.** Nothing inverts control. Nothing hides the provider — every
concrete provider exposes its raw client as `.client`. Every abstraction is ejectable:
drop the blueprint and keep the packs, drop the packs and keep the capabilities, drop
the capabilities and call the kernel directly, drop the kernel and use the raw
`httpx.Client`.

### The eleven invariants

1. **Sensitivity is a type, not a convention.** `Sensitive[T]` cannot reach a
   `public-cloud` provider without a declared redactor. Enforced at runtime.
2. **Providers declare capabilities; the runtime negotiates.** Never silently degrade.
3. **Everything is ejectable.**
4. **Determinism.** Identical inputs produce a byte-identical tree.
5. **Offline must work.** Every tool ships a mock; `ack demo --offline` runs with
   networking disabled.
6. **No telemetry, ever.** Stated in the CLI header and the README.
7. **Never fake progress.** No artificial delays.
8. **Domain is a pack, not the architecture.** `packs/_template/` ships from day one.
9. **Append-only terminal output.** No full-screen TUI.
10. **Non-TTY is first class.** Every command supports `--json`.
11. **One canonical implementation per tier; the spec is the source of truth.** Ports
    pass the published conformance suite or they do not ship.

---

## 2. Install and quickstart

```bash
# no install
uvx --from git+https://github.com/roshaninfordham/agenticcarekit ack --version

# ack on PATH
uv tool install git+https://github.com/roshaninfordham/agenticcarekit

# development checkout
git clone https://github.com/roshaninfordham/agenticcarekit && cd agenticcarekit
uv sync
uv run ack doctor
```

The verified 60-second path:

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/roshaninfordham/agenticcarekit \
  ack init care --blueprint on-device --yes --offline
cd care
uvx --from git+https://github.com/roshaninfordham/agenticcarekit ack demo --offline
# -> "✓ 0 bytes egressed — all inference stayed on this device."
```

Homebrew, Scoop, Docker, `curl | sh`, Nix, devcontainer feature, GitHub Action and
`npx create-agenticcarekit` are **roadmap**. They do not exist.

---

## 3. Support matrix

| Path | Status | What that actually means |
|---|---|---|
| Gemma 4 via Ollama (`e2b`, `e4b`, `12b`, `26b`, `31b`, `-mlx`) | **Supported** | Message builder conformance-verified: 20 `message-build` cases green on both Python and TypeScript. Transport tested against recorded Ollama `/api/chat` request and response shapes via `httpx.MockTransport` and stubs. **No live-network CI** — no assertion anywhere runs against a live Ollama daemon. |
| Cerebras | **Declared, untested** | `CerebrasProvider` is a preset over the OpenAI-compatible transport; declares `public-cloud` egress; reads `CEREBRAS_API_KEY` at call time. No recorded transcript, no live call. |
| OpenAI-compatible endpoints | **Declared, untested** | `OpenAICompatibleProvider` maps the same builder decisions onto `/chat/completions`. `top_k` cannot be expressed in that schema and is omitted rather than faked. |
| Python (kernel, capabilities, packs, CLI, sidecar, evals) | **Canonical** | 69/69 conformance; full suite green apart from one known failing test. |
| TypeScript (`packages/ts`) | **Kernel conformance-verified** | 69/69 on the same shared corpus. `extract` and `agents` ported but unit-tested only. `voice`, `rag`, and provider HTTP clients **not ported**. |
| `ack serve` sidecar + MCP | **Shipped** | Twelve HTTP routes under `/v1`, OpenAPI at `/openapi.json`, loopback bind with a `0600` token file, seven MCP tools over stdio. Smoke-verified; the newest surface in the project. |
| Go / Rust / Swift / Java / C# thin clients | **Roadmap** | The sidecar makes them possible; none generated yet. |
| Homebrew / Scoop / Docker / npx / Nix / GitHub Action | **Roadmap** | Not implemented. |

Blueprint demo status: `on-device` runs end to end offline; `voice-care` and
`care-copilot` scaffold correctly but their demos raise `TypeError` from
template/signature drift.

## 4. Repository layout

```
agenticcarekit/
├─ spec/                              Tier 0 — source of truth
│  ├─ schemas/*.json                  the five contracts as JSON Schema, plus errors
│  ├─ errors.json                     34 codes, shared by every language
│  └─ conformance/                    69 cases, a stdlib-only runner, two adapters
├─ packages/
│  ├─ agenticcarekit/                 the single top-level Python module
│  │  ├─ kernel/contracts/            the only import surface other tiers build against
│  │  ├─ kernel/providers/            ollama, cerebras, openai-compatible, mock, chain, builder, factory
│  │  ├─ kernel/policy/               Policy — the one enforcement path (+ THREATMODEL.md)
│  │  ├─ kernel/trace/                tracer, JSONL + console sinks, analysis
│  │  ├─ capabilities/                voice, agents, extract, rag
│  │  ├─ packs/                       healthcare, _template
│  │  ├─ blueprints/                  voice-care, care-copilot, on-device
│  │  ├─ cli/                         13 commands, detect/, recommend/
│  │  ├─ evals/                       harness, judge rubric (.md), scored table
│  │  └─ serve/                       ack serve — HTTP + MCP sidecar
│  └─ ts/                             TypeScript port — kernel + extract/agents
├─ tests/                             flat, named per workstream: test_<area>_<topic>.py
├─ docs/                              CONTRACTS.md, architecture, privacy, comparison, errors, recipes/
├─ registry.toml  llms.txt  llms-full.txt  AGENTS.md  CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md
└─ README.md  CHANGELOG.md  CONTRIBUTING.md  LICENSE
```

---

## 5. The five frozen contracts (verbatim)

The content below is `docs/CONTRACTS.md` reproduced in full. It is normative. If a
contract does not fit, the fix is to amend code + JSON Schema + that document in one
commit — never to patch around it downstream.

## The five frozen contracts

Phase 0 output. Everything in agenticcarekit is built against — and only
against — what is exported from `agenticcarekit.kernel.contracts`. Matching
JSON Schemas live in `spec/schemas/`; the shared error registry in
`spec/errors.json`.

**Rule for every workstream:** if a contract doesn't fit, the fix is to
amend the contract *here* (code + schema + this doc, one commit), never to
patch around it downstream. Contract drift discovered in integration is
resolved the same way.

Import surface:

```python
from agenticcarekit.kernel.contracts import (
    # Contract 1
    Modality, EgressClass, Capabilities, Provider,
    Message, TextPart, ImagePart, AudioPart, ToolCall,
    GenerateRequest, GenerateResponse, Chunk, Usage, VISION_TOKEN_BUDGETS,
    # Contract 2
    Sensitive, PolicyContext, Redactor, Redaction,
    # Contract 3
    tool, Tool, ToolSpec, Permission,
    # Contract 4
    TraceEvent, EventKind,
    # Contract 5
    AckConfig, ModelRef,
    # Errors
    AckError, CapabilityMismatch, PolicyViolation, explain, error_registry,
)
```

---

### Contract 1 — `Capabilities` and `Provider`

*File: `kernel/contracts/provider.py` · Schemas: `capabilities.schema.json`, `provider-spec.schema.json`*

Providers **declare** capabilities; the runtime negotiates. Never infer,
never silently degrade (invariant 2).

- `EgressClass`: `device` | `trusted-network` | `public-cloud`. The privacy
  boundary (Contract 2) is defined over these three classes and nothing else.
- `Capabilities.missing(**requirements)` returns human-readable gap strings
  (`["audio input", "tool calling"]`). These strings feed
  `CapabilityMismatch` errors verbatim — they are part of the contract.
- `Provider` is a `Protocol`: `name`, `capabilities()`, `generate(req)`,
  `stream(req)`. Anything satisfying it plugs in — including third-party
  plugins. Concrete providers must also expose their raw client
  (attribute `client` by convention) — nothing hides the provider.

Messages: `Message(role, parts, thinking, tool_calls, tool_call_id)`.

- `thinking` lives **outside** `parts`. That is what makes quirk 3
  (strip prior-turn thought blocks from history) structural: the message
  builder simply never serializes `thinking` for historical turns.
- `Message.required_modalities()` / `GenerateRequest.required_modalities()`
  drive pre-network capability checks (W-A acceptance).
- Image detail presets: `minimal=70, caption=140, default=280, detail=560,
  ocr=1120` (`VISION_TOKEN_BUDGETS`).

Sampling: `GenerateRequest` fields `temperature/top_p/top_k` default to
`None` = "apply the model's known-good defaults" (Gemma 4: 1.0 / 0.95 / 64).
Providers apply the defaults; user code overrides deliberately.

`think=True` → the provider injects `<|think|>` at the start of the system
prompt (quirk 2). Modality ordering (image/audio before text, quirk 4) is
the message builder's job, not the caller's.

---

### Contract 2 — `Sensitive[T]` and `PolicyContext`

*File: `kernel/contracts/policy.py`*

Sensitivity is a type, not a convention (invariant 1).

- `Sensitive(value, label=...)` is a **sealed box**: masked `repr`/`str`/
  `format`, refuses pickling, captures its construction call site in
  `.origin` (`file.py:123`).
- `Sensitive.unwrap_for(provider, policy)` is the *only* sanctioned path to
  the value on the way to a provider. It delegates to
  `PolicyContext.unwrap(value, provider)` — exactly one enforcement path.
- `Sensitive.dangerously_reveal()` exists for the policy engine
  post-authorization and for code that stays on-device by construction.
  The name is the audit trail; greppable in review.
- `Redactor` protocol: `name`, `redact(text) -> (clean_text, [Redaction])`.
  Implementations live in packs (`healthcare.phi`).
- `PolicyViolation` (E3xx) **must** carry `field_name`, `call_site`
  (from `Sensitive.origin`), and `provider`. A vague policy error is one
  nobody fixes.
- Every policy decision — allowed or denied — emits a `TraceEvent`
  (`kind="policy"` or `"redaction"`).

Enforcement matrix (W-B implements):

| value → provider egress | `device` | `trusted-network` | `public-cloud` |
|---|---|---|---|
| non-sensitive | allow | allow | allow |
| `Sensitive`, no redactor | allow | allow if policy egress ≥ trusted | **raise E301** |
| `Sensitive`, redactor declared | allow (raw) | allow (raw or redacted per policy) | allow **redacted only** |

Additionally: any provider whose egress class is broader than the
project's `[policy] egress` limit is refused outright (E303), sensitive or
not.

---

### Contract 3 — `@tool`

*File: `kernel/contracts/tools.py` · Schema: `tool-manifest.schema.json`*

One decorator, four artifacts: JSON schema (from type hints), permission
declaration (closed set: `network` / `sensitive` / `writes`), **mandatory
mock**, doc entry (the docstring).

- No mock → decoration fails with **E502**. Not at call time — at import.
- Unknown permission → **E503**.
- `Tool.spec` carries the `ToolSpec`; `ToolSpec.as_function_schema()` is
  the provider-facing declaration; `ToolSpec.to_manifest()` the
  `ack manifest` entry.
- Offline mode (`ack demo --offline`) dispatches to `spec.mock` instead of
  `spec.fn`. The swap happens in the agent loop (W-E), never inside Tool.

---

### Contract 4 — `TraceEvent`

*File: `kernel/contracts/trace.py` · Schema: `trace-event.schema.json`*

One schema for every model call, tool call, redaction, policy decision,
and error. Fields exactly: `ts, run_id, span_id, parent_span_id, kind,
egress, bytes_out, payload`.

- Wire format: JSONL, one event per line, `to_json()` = sorted keys, no
  whitespace drift (deterministic — invariant 4).
- `bytes_out` = bytes that left the process toward the provider for this
  event. The "0 bytes egressed" panel is
  `sum(e.bytes_out for e in run if e.egress != DEVICE) == 0`.
- `kind` is a closed set: `model | tool | redaction | policy | error`.
- Emitter, sinks (JSONL file, console view) and the eval harness are W-C;
  they consume this type, never extend it. New needs → amend here first.

Payload conventions (informative, not schema-enforced): `model` events
carry `{"model", "provider", "input_tokens", "output_tokens", "duration_ms"}`;
`redaction` events carry `{"redactor", "categories", "count"}`; `policy`
events carry `{"decision": "allow"|"allow-redacted"|"deny", "reason", "call_site"}`.

---

### Contract 5 — `ack.toml`

*File: `kernel/contracts/config.py` · Schema: `ack-toml.schema.json`*

Declarative project state: `[project] blueprint/pack`, `[model]
primary/fallback` (as `provider:model` refs), `[policy] egress/redactor`,
`[capabilities] enabled`.

- `AckConfig.load(path)` / `from_dict()` raise E40x errors naming the
  exact missing/invalid key.
- `AckConfig.to_toml()` is deterministic (byte-identical for identical
  configs).
- Unknown keys are **preserved** (`raw` holds the full parsed dict) —
  users and agents may extend the file; `ack sync` must never destroy
  their edits.

---

### Errors (cross-cutting)

*File: `kernel/contracts/errors.py` · Registry: `spec/errors.json` · Schema: `errors.schema.json`*

- `AckError(message, code=, why=, fix=, details=)`; `render()` produces the
  canonical CLI shape; `to_dict()` the `--json`/MCP shape.
- Code ranges: E0xx environment · E1xx model/provider/network · E2xx
  capability · E3xx policy · E4xx config · E5xx generation · E6xx eval.
- New error codes are **added to `spec/errors.json` first**, then raised in
  code. A code raised but not registered is a test failure (W-J enforces).

---

### Canonical message build (binds W-A and W-J)

`build_ollama_chat(req: GenerateRequest, model: str) -> dict` in
`kernel/providers/builder.py` is the single quirk-application point. Its
output is the exact Ollama `/api/chat` payload and the conformance
fixtures assert it byte-for-byte (as sorted-key JSON):

```json
{
  "model": "gemma4:e4b",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "<|think|>You are..."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "...", "images": ["<b64>"], "audio": ["<b64>"]}
  ],
  "tools": [ ...ToolSpec.as_function_schema()... ],
  "options": {"temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 64},
  "stream": false
}
```

Rules, in order:
1. Sampling defaults 1.0/0.95/64 land in `options`; request overrides win.
   `max_tokens` → `options.num_predict`; `stop` → `options.stop`;
   context is NOT sent (the model declares it).
2. `think=True` → prepend `<|think|>` to the system message content
   (creating a system message if none exists). Exactly once, at the start.
3. History hygiene: `Message.thinking` is NEVER serialized for any turn.
   Assistant `tool_calls` serialize to Ollama's `tool_calls` field; `tool`
   role turns carry `tool_call_id` as `tool_name` mapping per Ollama.
4. Modality order: within a message, images/audio serialize to their
   `images`/`audio` arrays (which Ollama places before text); multiple
   text parts join with "\n\n" into `content`.
5. `ImagePart.detail` preset maps to `options.vision_tokens` using
   `VISION_TOKEN_BUDGETS` when any image is present (highest preset wins
   across images).
6. Bytes data → base64; str data that is an existing file path → read and
   base64; other str → assumed already-base64 (passed through).

### Blueprint layout (binds W-G and W-I)

A blueprint is `packages/agenticcarekit/blueprints/<name>/` containing:

- `blueprint.toml` — `[blueprint] name, description, track`;
  `[requires] modalities_in = [...], tool_calling = bool,
  context_tokens = int`; `[defaults] capabilities = [...], pack = "..."`.
- `templates/` — the generated tree. Files ending `.tmpl` are rendered by
  simple `{{var}}` substitution then the suffix is stripped; everything
  else is copied verbatim. Renderer (W-G) substitutes exactly:
  `project_name`, `blueprint`, `pack`, `model_primary`, `model_fallback`,
  `egress`, `redactor`, `capabilities_list`, `ack_version`. Unknown
  `{{...}}` in a `.tmpl` file is an E501 error, not silence.
- `README.md` — states the decision-support-only scope.

Generation is deterministic: identical inputs → byte-identical trees
(no timestamps, no absolute paths, sorted file iteration).

### Conventions binding all workstreams

- Python ≥ 3.11. Imports always via the single top-level module
  (`from agenticcarekit.kernel.contracts import ...`).
- Tests live in `tests/test_<area>_*.py` (flat, exclusively named per
  workstream). Run: `uv run pytest`.
- Do not edit `pyproject.toml`; needed deps go in your report.
- Do not run git commands; the orchestrator commits.
- Prompts are `.md` files, never string literals.
- Public functions carry docstrings with runnable examples.
- No telemetry, no artificial delays, no full-screen TUIs, append-only
  terminal output, `--json` everywhere (invariants 6–10).

---

## 6. CLI command reference

Global: `ack --version`, `ack --help`. Every command accepts `--json` and emits

```json
{"envelope_version": 1, "ok": true, "command": "<name>", "version": "0.1.0",
 "elapsed_ms": null, "data": {}, "error": null}
```

Failure sets `ok: false`, fills `error` with `{code, title, what, why, fix, details}`,
and returns a non-zero process exit status. `envelope_version` is `1`. A published
`spec/schemas/cli-envelope.schema.json` is roadmap.

The CLI header is printed on every command: `agenticcarekit 0.1.0 · ack — No telemetry, ever.`

### `ack init [path]`

Probe the machine, recommend a model, and generate a project.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--blueprint`, `-b` | `voice-care`, `care-copilot`, `on-device`, or a custom one on the search path |
| `--model`, `-m` | pin the model, e.g. `gemma4:e4b-mlx` |
| `--providers` | comma-separated chain, e.g. `ollama,cerebras` |
| `--pack` | `healthcare`, `_template`, or an installed third-party pack |
| `--capabilities` | comma-separated: `voice`, `agents`, `extract`, `rag` |
| `--name` | project name (defaults to the directory name) |
| `--blueprint-path` | extra blueprint search directory |
| `--yes`, `-y` | ask nothing |
| `--why` | print the full ranked table including every eliminated candidate |
| `--no-pull` | do not download the model |
| `--no-git` | do not run `git init` |
| `--offline` | no network: mocks and local only |
| `--json` | machine-readable |

Generates `ack.toml`, `app/`, `Makefile`, `README.md`, `.gitignore`, `pyproject.toml`,
and the agent surface (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` symlink, `.cursor/rules/`,
`.github/copilot-instructions.md`). Running it twice with the same inputs produces a
byte-identical tree.

### `ack doctor`

Report the machine honestly, with problems as fixable error codes. Options: `--offline`,
`--json`. `data.facts` is a serializable `MachineFacts`; `data.problems` is a list of
`{code, title, what, fix}`. Thirteen probes run concurrently with independent timeouts;
a failed probe reports `status: "unknown"` or `"skipped"` and never blocks.
`provider_keys` values are **booleans** — key values are never read or logged.

### `ack explain [code]`

Print the long form of an error code from `spec/errors.json`. Case-insensitive.
Options: `--json`.

### `ack new [kind] [name]`

Scaffold an extension point. `kind` is one of `blueprint`, `capability`, `pack`,
`provider`, `redactor`. Options: `--path`, `--json`. Writes working examples, not stubs.

### `ack manifest`

Machine-readable description of a generated project: `manifest_version`, `project`,
`model`, `policy`, `capabilities`, `files`, `tools`, `tool_notes`. A tool module that
fails to import produces a note, never an exception. Options: `--path`, `--json`.

### `ack sync`

Reconcile the project tree against `ack.toml`, regenerating the agent surface. Unknown
keys in `ack.toml` are preserved — users and agents may extend the file. Options:
`--path`, `--force`, `--json`.

### `ack add [capability]`

Enable a capability in `ack.toml`. Known first-party capabilities: `agents`, `extract`,
`rag`, `voice`. Options: `--path`, `--json`.

### `ack swap [what] [value]`

Swap `model`, `fallback`, `pack`, `redactor`, or `egress`. Options: `--path`, `--json`.
Returns `{what, from, to}`.

### `ack eject [thing]`

Inline a packaged abstraction into your source. Today the only registered ejectable is
`prompts`, which copies every packaged prompt `.md` into `./prompts/`. Never clobbers
without `--force`. Options: `--path`, `--force`, `--json`.

### `ack check`

Lint plus a fast selftest (the contract doctests), under a 30-second budget. Returns
`{ok, budget_seconds, within_budget, duration_ms, steps: [{name, status, duration_ms, detail}]}`.
Non-zero exit status on failure. Options: `--path`, `--json`.

### `ack eval`

Score the project against its golden set at `evals/*.jsonl`. Each line is
`{"id", "input", "expected"}`. `--offline` scores against exact match with a mock
provider; otherwise the project's provider chain is resolved via `provider_for`.
Raises **E601** when no golden set exists. Options: `--path`, `--offline`, `--json`.

### `ack demo`

Run the project's demo — prefers `make demo`, falls back to `python app/main.py`.
`--offline` sets `ACK_OFFLINE=1` so every tool dispatches to its mock and
`provider_for` returns a `MockProvider`. Non-zero exit status when the demo fails.
Options: `--path`, `--offline`, `--json`.

### Environment variables

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `ACK_OFFLINE=1` | same as `--offline` |
| `ACK_MACHINE_FACTS=<path>` | inject a recorded `MachineFacts` JSON instead of probing |
| `ACK_BLUEPRINT_PATH=<dir>` | extra blueprint search path |
| `ACK_THROUGHPUT_URL=<url>` | override the network throughput probe endpoint |
| `OLLAMA_MODELS` | model directory used by the disk probe |
| `NO_COLOR` / `FORCE_COLOR` | both respected; `NO_COLOR` wins |

### `ack serve`

Run the local sidecar: the kernel over HTTP, or MCP for agents. Options: `--path`,
`--host` (default `127.0.0.1`), `--port` (default `4422`), `--mcp` (MCP over stdio;
stdout becomes the transport so the banner goes to stderr), `--allow-remote` (permit a
non-loopback bind, deliberately), `--json`.

Writes a `0600` token file at `<project>/.ack/serve.token`; send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Twelve routes, all returning the standard envelope:

```
GET  /v1/health          GET  /v1/doctor        GET  /v1/manifest
GET  /v1/models          GET  /v1/errors/{code} GET  /v1/trace
GET  /v1/trace/stream    POST /v1/init          POST /v1/generate
POST /v1/check           POST /v1/eval          POST /v1/capabilities/add
```

OpenAPI at `/openapi.json`, rendered at `/docs`. Generate clients from it.

MCP tool surface — a deliberately closed list (`serve/mcp_server.py::TOOL_NAMES`):
`init_project`, `add_capability`, `doctor`, `run_eval`, `get_manifest`,
`search_models`, `explain_error`. `ACK_SERVE_ROOT` names the project root for MCP
clients that cannot pass `--path`.

### Roadmap commands

`ack verify-plugin <name>` (run the conformance suite against a third-party plugin) and
`ack eval --init` (scaffold a golden set — referenced by E601's fix string but not
implemented).

---

## 7. Error registry

Registry version 1.0.0 · 34 codes · source `spec/errors.json`.

A new code is added to the registry **first**, then raised in code. A code raised but
not registered is a test failure (`tests/test_conformance_registry.py`).

| Range | Domain |
|---|---|
| `E0xx` | bootstrap / environment |
| `E1xx` | model / provider / network |
| `E2xx` | capability mismatch |
| `E3xx` | policy and privacy violations |
| `E4xx` | project config |
| `E5xx` | generation / templates |
| `E6xx` | eval |

| Code | Title | What | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **E001** | Python version too old | agenticcarekit requires Python 3.11 or newer. | `uv python install 3.12 && uv run ack doctor` |
| **E010** | Ollama is not installed | no ollama binary was found on PATH. | `brew install ollama   # or: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh \| sh` |
| **E011** | Ollama daemon is not running | the ollama binary exists but the daemon did not answer on 127.0.0.1:11434. | `ollama serve   # then re-run your command` |
| **E012** | Microphone dependency not installed | the local mic adapter needs the optional sounddevice package and it is not installed. | `uv pip install sounddevice   # or use MockASR / the Twilio adapter` |
| **E013** | Optional extra not installed | a command needs an optional dependency group that is not installed (e.g. the [serve] extra). | `uv pip install "agenticcarekit[serve]"   # the error's fix line names the exact extra` |
| **E020** | Not enough disk space for the selected model | free disk at the model directory is below model size × 1.15. | `free up space, or pick a smaller model: ack init --model gemma4:e2b` |
| **E021** | Not enough RAM for the selected model | available RAM is below the model's working-set requirement (size / 0.6 rule). | `pick a smaller model: ack init --model gemma4:e2b   # or use a hosted primary` |
| **E022** | Model variant does not fit this platform | the selected variant targets different hardware (e.g. an -mlx tag off Apple Silicon). | `let detection choose: ack init   # or pick the base tag, e.g. gemma4:e4b` |
| **E030** | Project root not writable | agenticcarekit needed to create a file under the project root and the filesystem refused. | `ack serve --path <a directory you can write to>` |
| **E101** | Model pull failed | the model download did not complete. | `re-run the same command — the pull resumes where it stopped` |
| **E102** | Provider request failed | the provider returned an error or timed out. | `check 'ack doctor', or configure a fallback: [model] fallback = "cerebras:gemma-4-31b"` |
| **E110** | Network unreachable | a network probe or provider call could not reach its host. | `ack demo --offline   # everything runs against mocks with networking disabled` |
| **E120** | Provider API key missing | a hosted provider is configured but its API key env var is not set. | `export CEREBRAS_API_KEY=...   # presence is checked, the value is never logged` |
| **E130** | Sidecar token rejected | a request to ack serve arrived without a valid bearer token. | `Authorization: Bearer $(cat .ack/serve.token)` |
| **E201** | Context window too small | the blueprint's required context exceeds the model's context window. | `pick a 256K-context model: ack init --model gemma4:12b` |
| **E202** | Tool calling not supported | the blueprint requires native function calling and this model/provider pair does not declare it. | `ack init --model gemma4:e4b   # all Gemma 4 tags declare tool calling via Ollama` |
| **E203** | Model does not support a required input modality | a request or blueprint needs an input modality (e.g. audio) this model lacks. | `ack init --model gemma4:e4b-mlx` |
| **E204** | Model does not support a required output modality | the request needs an output modality the model cannot produce. | `ack add voice   # wires a TTS provider next to the model` |
| **E301** | Sensitive value blocked at egress boundary | a Sensitive[T] value was about to reach a public-cloud provider with no redactor declared. | `declare a redactor: [policy] redactor = "healthcare.phi"   # or keep egress = "device"` |
| **E302** | Declared redactor not found | ack.toml names a redactor that no installed pack provides. | `ack doctor --json \| grep redactors   # then fix [policy] redactor in ack.toml` |
| **E303** | Egress attempted above configured limit | a provider with a broader egress class than [policy] egress was invoked. | `use a device/trusted provider, or deliberately raise [policy] egress in ack.toml` |
| **E401** | Invalid ack.toml | ack.toml exists but could not be parsed or a field is malformed. | `ack sync   # reconciles and rewrites a valid ack.toml, preserving your values` |
| **E402** | ack.toml missing a required section | [project] and [model] are required and one is absent. | `ack sync` |
| **E403** | Invalid egress class in ack.toml | [policy] egress is not one of device, trusted-network, public-cloud. | `set [policy] egress = "device"` |
| **E404** | No ack.toml in this directory | the command needs a project and none was found here. | `ack init` |
| **E410** | Unknown blueprint | the named blueprint is not installed. | `ack init --blueprint on-device` |
| **E411** | Unknown pack | the named pack is not installed. | `uv pip install <pack-package>   # or: ack new pack` |
| **E501** | Template rendering failed | a blueprint template did not render. | `re-run with --json for the failing template path, and file an issue` |
| **E502** | Tool declared without a mock | @tool was applied with no mock implementation. | `@tool(mock=mock_yourtool, ...)  # return canned, realistic data` |
| **E503** | Unknown tool permission | a permission outside network/sensitive/writes was declared. | `use permissions={"network"} (or "sensitive", "writes")` |
| **E504** | Structured extraction failed validation | the model's output did not match the requested schema, and the single repair attempt did not fix it. | `ack demo --json   # 'details' carries both raw outputs; tighten the schema or the prompt` |
| **E601** | Eval golden set missing | ack eval found no golden set for this blueprint/pack. | `ack eval --init   # scaffolds a golden set from the pack's clinical eval sets` |
| **E602** | Eval scoring failed | the judge model call failed while scoring. | `re-run; or score offline against exact-match only: ack eval --offline` |
| **E603** | Generated demo failed | the project's demo exited non-zero. | `ack demo --offline   # runs against mocks; then ack doctor for environment causes` |

Known drift: E601's fix references `ack eval --init`, which is not implemented.

---

## 8. The privacy boundary

Three egress classes and nothing else: `device` (never leaves the machine),
`trusted-network` (self-hosted, user-controlled), `public-cloud` (third-party API).

| value → provider egress | `device` | `trusted-network` | `public-cloud` |
|---|---|---|---|
| non-sensitive | allow | allow | allow |
| `Sensitive`, no redactor | allow | allow if policy egress >= trusted | **raise E301** |
| `Sensitive`, redactor declared | allow (raw) | allow (raw by default) | allow **redacted only** |

Above the table: any provider whose declared egress is broader than the project's
`[policy] egress` is refused outright with **E303**, sensitive or not, checked before
the value is revealed.

Minimal working example:

```python
from agenticcarekit.kernel.contracts import EgressClass, Sensitive
from agenticcarekit.kernel.policy import Policy
from agenticcarekit.kernel.providers import CerebrasProvider
from agenticcarekit.packs.healthcare import PHIRedactor

policy = Policy(
    egress=EgressClass.PUBLIC_CLOUD,
    redactors={"healthcare.phi": PHIRedactor()},
    default_redactor="healthcare.phi",
)
note = Sensitive("Patient Maria Alvarez, MRN 4482911, DOB 03/14/1979.", label="intake_note")
note.unwrap_for(CerebrasProvider("gemma-4-31b"), policy)
# 'Patient [NAME-1], MRN [MRN-1], DOB [DATE-1].'
```

Guarantees: one enforcement path (`Policy.unwrap`); E301 carries field label, exact
construction call site and provider; E302 fires at `Policy` construction for a redactor
no installed pack provides; non-text sensitive payloads are refused rather than
stringified; trace payloads carry decisions and category names but never the value or
the removed spans.

Limits, stated plainly: the guarantee is against **accident, not malice** —
`value._Sensitive__value` is reachable in Python and that gap is asserted as a test. A
provider that lies about its declared egress defeats the boundary. Once `unwrap`
returns, the value is an ordinary `str` and carries no taint. The engine cannot judge
whether a redactor is any good.

**Not claimed:** HIPAA compliance, Safe Harbor certification, SOC 2 / HITRUST / ISO /
FDA anything, medical-device status, or validation on real patient data. The
`healthcare.phi` redactor measures **precision 0.9688 / recall 0.9394** on its own
33-sentence labelled set — regex and wordlist de-identification, with `NAME` and `DATE`
carrying the misses.

Proving zero egress:

```python
from agenticcarekit.kernel.trace import read_jsonl, bytes_egressed, assert_zero_egress
events = read_jsonl("trace.jsonl")
assert bytes_egressed(events) == 0      # sums bytes_out where egress != device
assert_zero_egress(events)              # raises AckError E303 naming the offenders
```

---

## 9. Gemma 4 ground truth

Current as of July 2026, verified against Ollama's registry and Google's model card.
Do not invent facts beyond this table.

| Ollama tag | Size | Context | Modalities in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4:e2b` | 7.2 GB | 128K | text, image, **audio** |
| `gemma4:e4b` | 9.6 GB | 128K | text, image, **audio** |
| `gemma4:12b` | 7.6 GB | 256K | text, image |
| `gemma4:26b` | 18 GB | 256K | text, image |
| `gemma4:31b` | 20 GB | 256K | text, image |

- `-mlx` variants exist for Apple Silicon (`gemma4:e4b-mlx`); preferred on arm64 Darwin.
- `gemma4:cloud` and `gemma4:31b-cloud` are hosted — no download.
- "E" means *effective* parameters: E2B ≈ 2.3B, E4B ≈ 4.5B. 26B is MoE with ~3.8B
  active; 31B is dense.
- **Output is text only on every variant.** No native speech output — TTS is always a
  separate provider.

### The seven behavioural quirks, all applied in `build_ollama_chat`

1. Sampling defaults `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`, `top_k=64`.
2. Thinking is enabled by a `<|think|>` token at the start of the system prompt;
   exposed as `chat(..., think=True)`.
3. **Prior-turn thought blocks must be stripped from history.** `Message.thinking` lives
   outside `parts` and is never serialized for any turn — the fix is structural.
4. Image and audio must precede text in the prompt.
5. Vision token budgets: 70 / 140 / 280 / 560 / 1120, exposed as presets
   (`minimal`, `caption`, `default`, `detail`, `ocr`).
6. Native `system` role is supported (unlike Gemma 3). Use it.
7. Native function calling is supported. Use it rather than prompt-hacking JSON.

---

## 10. Extension points

Five, all first-class, all discoverable, each scaffolded by `ack new`.

| Point | Interface | Scaffolded by |
|---|---|---|
| Provider | `Provider` protocol | `ack new provider` |
| Redactor | `Redactor` protocol | `ack new redactor` |
| Pack | pack manifest + models/redactors | `ack new pack` |
| Capability | capability manifest | `ack new capability` |
| Blueprint | `blueprint.toml` + `templates/` | `ack new blueprint` |

Discovery is by Python entry points — the `agenticcarekit.packs` group is declared and
used today; the inventory of what ships in the box is `registry.toml`:

```toml
[project.entry-points."agenticcarekit.packs"]
cardio = "mypackage.cardio"
```

Install the package and the pack appears; no central registration. `registry.toml` lists
first-party plugins only. `ack verify-plugin` is roadmap; until then, run the shared
corpus directly: `python3 spec/conformance/runner.py <adapter-command>`. Do not vendor
the fixtures — a port that copies them has forked the spec.

Every default is overridable in `ack.toml`, and `ack eject` inlines an abstraction into
user source.

---

## 11. Verification commands

```bash
uv run pytest -q                       # 514 pass, 1 known failure
uv run ruff check packages tests spec
uv run ruff format --check packages tests spec

# conformance — both must report 69/69 passed · 0 failed · 0 skipped
uv run python spec/conformance/runner.py -- uv run python spec/conformance/adapters/python.py
python3 spec/conformance/runner.py node spec/conformance/adapters/typescript.mjs

# TypeScript unit tests (45), after a build
cd packages/ts && npm install && npm run build && npm test

# inside a generated project
ack check --json
ack demo --offline
```

The TypeScript pytest gate skips when Node or the build is missing. **A skip is not a
pass.**

Two hazards worth knowing: `uv run pytest` from the repo root currently writes generated
fixture files into the repo root (`README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `ack.toml`, `app/`,
`prompts/`, `providers/`, `.cursor/`), and
`tests/test_cli_commands.py::test_eval_with_a_golden_set_but_no_provider_chain_names_the_gap`
fails because it asserts pre-`provider_for` behaviour.

---

## 12. Known issues and roadmap

**Known issues at 0.1.0**

1. `ack doctor` and `ack explain` crash when installed from a wheel —
   `_registry_path()` in `kernel/contracts/errors.py` resolves `spec/errors.json` one
   directory too high for an installed layout. Works in a repo checkout.
2. `voice-care` and `care-copilot` demos raise `TypeError`: the templates call
   `VoiceLoop(provider=...)` and `AgentLoop(system_prompt=...)`, but the landed
   signatures are `VoiceLoop(asr, llm, tts, *, system_prompt_path=...)` and
   `AgentLoop(provider, tools, *, max_steps, offline, emit)`.
3. `ack eval --init` is referenced by E601 but not implemented.
4. One failing test (see above).
5. `uv run pytest` from the repo root litters the repo root.
6. Only `prompts` is ejectable.

**Roadmap** — none of this exists; nothing here is a claim.

Tier 2 thin clients in Go, Rust,
Java/Kotlin, Swift, C# generated from the sidecar's OpenAPI spec · Tier 3 installers (Homebrew,
Scoop, Docker, `curl | sh`, Nix flake, devcontainer feature, GitHub Action, npx) ·
`ack verify-plugin` · `spec/schemas/cli-envelope.schema.json` · live-network integration
tests against a real Ollama daemon.
